analysis.title: GS ETF Color - overdrive...
key_insights: ETFs were 36% of overall equity tape on Friday 11/20, the highest since April, as investors turn to macro products to hedge or express tactical views.
NDX has fallen 20% in only 33 sessions, erasing nearly $8 trillion in market cap.
S&P 500 closed lower 7 straight sessions, its longest losing streak since February 2020, with a -9% move over the stretch.
Semiconductor ETFs had their worst week in the history of nearly all flagship sub-sector ETFs (-17%).
Broader tech, momentum, growth, EM, DM ex-US and miners each posted their worst week since 2020.
Gold is in its worst rolling 12-month stretch since August 2021 (-14%).
Nearly 70% of US equity ETFs hit 6-month lows after Friday, one of the highest shares in a decade.
Despite the price damage, US equity ETFs took in more than $200B since NDX's October peak, one of the largest 33-session inflow stretches in the dataset.
S&P 500 ETFs drew over $60B and NDX ETFs nearly $25B. Levered ETFs gathered $20B during the NDX drawdown.
US-listed ETFs have taken in over $1.9T YTD, up 60% yoy and accelerating since October, on track to pass $2T by year-end.
SPY, QQQ and IWM were ~32% of notional ETF volume last week, the highest in 8 weeks, but more than 400 ETFs traded $100mm+ on Friday, a top 5 occurrence.
Volume tails are fattening: an average 2026 session has ~290 ETFs trading $100mm+ versus ~105 in 2019, with almost 6k US-listed ETFs.
risk_factors: Nearly 70% of US equity ETFs at 6-month lows signals broad-based weakness.
Leveraged ETF inflows during a sharp drawdown add potential for forced flows if declines continue.
Semis and momentum selling has spread to EM, DM ex-US and miners.
vol_and_positioning: Net leverage has been pared back and pain tolerances are being tested.
ETFs were 36% of equity market volume on Friday, the highest since April.
Levered ETFs took in $20B of inflows alongside the -20% NDX drawdown, indicating dip-buying via leverage.
Broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM) drive volume when volatility spikes, ~32% of notional ETF volume last week.

tension_points.bull_case: ETF inflows are at some of the strongest levels in history, with over $200B into US equity ETFs since the NDX peak and $1.9T YTD, showing persistent dip-buying demand.
tension_points.bear_case: Price action is poor, with NDX down 20% in 33 sessions, nearly 70% of US equity ETFs at 6-month lows and record-type weekly losses across semis, tech and EM.

theme_stances.key_argument: While performance and price action have suffered over six weeks, flows into the ETF ecosystem are at some of their strongest levels in history.
